notes: vertical_drag_area_m2 stands in for the drag of the rotor disc in vertical flow (no autorotation model): DESIGN.
Power is 2 x 1,636 kW (VK-2500); rotor diameter 17.2 m; gross weight 10,700 kg; g limits +3/-0.5, all from the source.
Cross-check (unit test): at the sourced 3,600 m OGE hover ceiling the model holds about the gross weight.
Vne is an ESTIMATE (the source gives none): 1.1 x the sourced 320 km/h top speed.

War Thunder fit (user request 2026-10-25): top speed at 1,000 m and climb rate are the official wiki characteristics (upgraded, Realistic Battles); the engine power is scaled and the drag area derived to meet both together (fit_climb), then the power is raised if needed so a hover at 1,000 m takes at most 85 % collective (fit_hover, DESIGN: War Thunder helicopters hover with margin; their published climb rate alone would leave too little power for it, so the model climbs faster than that figure); engine_power_w below is the real figure before scaling. The drag area absorbs the blade profile power the model does not count separately.
tail_rotor_power_fraction 0.1: typical tail rotor share (Leishman, Principles of Helicopter Aerodynamics), ESTIMATE.
mass_kg DERIVED: War Thunder base weight 9.0 t (Mi-28N) plus 30 min of its 1.52 t / 95 min of fuel.
